in_sanskrit.name: Imteyaz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Trust in God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Imteyaz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from Arabic ‘imtī‘āz meaning trust or faith, this name signifies one who has complete faith in God and relies on divine guidance.

in_marathi.name: Imteyaz
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Trust in God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Imteyaz हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Arabic ‘imtī‘āz meaning trust or faith, this name signifies one who has complete faith in God and relies on divine guidance.
